name: Ingenhousz on light and plant gases
description: Jan Ingenhousz related the effect of green plants on air to sunlight, distinguishing it from their effect at night.

impact.note: Extended earlier findings on plants and air by showing the role of light; known to naturalists, and photosynthesis research grew from it.

date.basis: Date of the cited publication or documented episode; not a claim that the underlying work began that year.

events.statement: Ingenhousz’s 1779 work described the role of sunlight in the effect of green plants on air.
events.scope: Jan Ingenhousz related the effect of green plants on air to sunlight, distinguishing it from their effect at night.
events.caveats: This finding is one stage in the history of photosynthesis; it did not establish the complete modern account of carbon fixation or energy conversion.

evidence.supports: The historical review dates the work and describes the sunlight and nighttime distinction.
